question: is the elixir lane's former wired grammar (the 2024 tree-sitter-wasms prebuilt) or upstream 0.3.5 the better grammar for this lane's corpora?

method.damage: ERROR nodes and MISSING tokens counted over all children (not named children only)
method.shapeDigest: sha256 over the multiset of `type[field]` labels of named nodes — structure and field names, text and positions excluded
method.leafDigest: sha256 over the multiset of leaf `type\u0001text` — distinguishes re-shaping from content loss

grammars.label: incumbent-2024-prebuilt
grammars.provenance: tree-sitter-wasms@0.1.13/out wasm — the build the repo's wasm/ carried until this round (byte-identical; the swap to 0.3.5 happened in this round, so the incumbent is pinned here by its own local copy)

grammars.label: upstream-0.3.5
grammars.provenance: npm tree-sitter-elixir@0.3.5 tarball wasm (now wired at wasm/tree-sitter-elixir.wasm)
